summary: ITER-188 PAMM Strategy Marketplace (publish + join funnel) + Automatic Risk Sweeps — full stack verified. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_iter188_pamm_marketplace_sweep.py re-ran 7/7 PASS in ~10s (publish flow + visibility, publish-requires-manager 403 on plain user, full request/approve flow with allocation + notification, reject flow + unpublished 404, sweep_once enforcement + record, sweep loop registered in background_loops, sweep-status auth-gated). Frontend Playwright E2E on external preview URL: admin (admin@stoicaibot.com) at /managed sees pamm-program-select (Alpha Managed Fund), pamm-publish-button toggles PUBLISH TO MARKETPLACE → PUBLISHED, pamm-sweep-chip shows 'AUTO-SWEEP {N}s AGO · 1 CHECKED' and advances (34s→64s→72s across page loads). Investor (freshly-registered example.com user w/ email_verified flipped in Mongo) at /marketplace: BOT PRESETS default renders market-grid; MANAGED STRATEGIES tab shows single pamm-listing-{pid} card with fee 20% / LIVE badge / RETURN 0.19% / MAX DD 0% / AUM 100,311.8 / INVESTORS 0 (no manager_id/broker_program_id/risk_limits leaked). join-open→join-amount→join-note→join-submit flow succeeds with toast 'Request sent — the manager will review it'; card switches to REQUEST PENDING REVIEW (join-pending-{pid}), pamm-my-requests renders row with PENDING status chip. Admin reload of /managed shows pamm-join-requests-panel with 1 pending, join-approve-{rid} click triggers toast 'Approved — allocation created on broker', queue empties (No pending requests.), investor row moves to APPROVED, and pamm-investors-panel shows new allocation (inv_d68628fb30 · 5,000). Marketplace API GET /api/pamm/marketplace confirms only clean listing fields returned. Also verified admin publish stays PUBLISHED and browser reload roundtrips. REGRESSION: BOT PRESETS tab market-grid still renders (preset cards); all existing /managed panels (KPIs, RISK ENGINE with limits, BROKER HEALTH ping showing Sandbox HEALTHY 100 · 0.9ms, INVESTORS · ALLOCATIONS listing existing inv_003977c283 10,000) unaffected. Notes: preview auto-refresh occasionally shows a blank frame right after page.reload() before Vite HMR re-hydrates (screenshot inv_empty.jpg + inv_approved.jpg blank once) — API state (verified via HTTP) is correct; second render always fills — cosmetic preview-hosting artifact, not a code bug.

issues: 'Marketplace' link appears twice — once in PRODUCTS section and once in TRADING section — same route, both highlight active. Same duplication noted in iter-117 for Analytics. Consider retiring the legacy TRADING/INSIGHTS duplicates now that PRODUCTS is authoritative.

INVESTORS metric on card shows the LIVE program.investor_count which only updates after RECONCILE (documented behavior for /managed KPI). After a join is approved it still reads 0 until next reconcile — could confuse marketplace visitors.

critical_code_review_comments: PammMarketplace.load() only refetches on component mount (useEffect [load]); after a join is approved and the user reloads /marketplace, if the presets tab is default the my-requests fetch happens once. If the user stays on the managed tab the tab remount refreshes — OK. Consider a lightweight polling or event refresh for status transitions from PENDING → APPROVED without a hard reload.

OnboardingWizard is a full-screen z-[80] modal that appears on every route for fresh users and blocks marketplace/managed clicks — that's expected UX but pytest/playwright agents must PUT /api/onboarding {status:'done'} for freshly-registered test users (or click data-testid='wizard-skip') before UI testing. Recommend adding a testing-only env bypass or auto-dismiss for accounts with a specific role flag.

ListingCard exposes program_id (uuid) in data-testid which is fine, but does not surface a 'view details' modal with a pitch — currently ONLY name+fee+return+DD+AUM+investors are visible. Backend accepts a `pitch` on the publish body but the UI has no field to enter it and does not render it on the card. If pitch is a first-class product signal, add both editor + reader.
Managed tab renders a 'Loading managed strategies…' text without a data-testid — worth adding pamm-market-loading for deterministic test waits.
GET /api/pamm/marketplace correctly omits manager_id/broker_program_id/risk_limits (verified via curl). Good — internal-field leakage nailed shut.
